description: A PHP template file for rendering the 'admin-users' section within an admin panel layout, including header, search box, and script inclusion.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Sets the layout template for the current view.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Defines a section in the template for content insertion.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a partial template into the current view.

methods.name: supply
methods.description: Provides content for a named section.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces content in a section, ending the current section.

methods.name: asset
methods.description: Generates URL for a static asset.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends content to an existing section.
